github.description: Official GitHub MCP server — pull requests, issues, workflows, repository context, and code search in Copilot chat.

fetch.description: HTTP client for testing API endpoints, data sources, and webhooks directly in chat.

gitkraken.description: Git blame, log, diff, branch ops, and PR workflow. Avoids manual git log parsing.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare Workers, Pages, D1, KV, and R2 management from chat.

memory.description: Persistent key-value memory for agent context across sessions.

sequentialthinking.description: Structured multi-step reasoning for complex problem decomposition.

context7.description: Retrieves current, version-accurate documentation for npm packages — prevents hallucinated APIs.

brave-search.description: Brave Web Search — finds blog posts, StackOverflow answers, GitHub issues, and docs not covered by Context7.
